name: ThermHex polypropylene honeycomb (core only)
note: ThermHex brochure: nominal density 80 kg/m3, shear modulus 6 MPa (L) and 15 MPa (W) by ASTM C273, compression modulus 40 MPa. A honeycomb has almost no stiffness in its own plane, so it is a sandwich core only; the shear through it is the geometric mean of L and W, a lab estimate.
